name: input-group-ai-prompts
title: AI prompt inputs
description: AI prompt inputs. Core/Input pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Input and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.

'use client'; import { useState } from 'react'; import { DropdownMenuRoot as DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItemPrimitive as DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparatorPrimitive as DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuTrigger } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/DropdownMenu'; import { FieldRoot as Field } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Field'; import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput, InputGroupTextarea, InputGroupText } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Input'; import { RegistryIcon } from '@gaudi/design-system/icons/RegistryIcon'; const models = ['Balanced', 'Fast', 'Deep reasoning']; const tools = [ { icon: 'PaperclipIcon', label: 'Add photos and files' }, { icon: 'ImageIcon', label: 'Create image' }, { icon: 'SearchIcon', label: 'Deep research' } ]; const more = [ { icon: 'BookOpenIcon', label: 'Study and learn' }, { icon: 'LayoutDashboardIcon', label: 'Canvas' } ]; export function Pattern() { const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(''); const [draft, setDraft] = useState(''); const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(''); const [model, setModel] = useState(models[0]); const [webSearch, setWebSearch] = useState(false); return (
{/* Single-line prompt bar: a tools menu, the prompt, voice actions. */} {tools.map((tool) => ( setFeedback(`${tool.label} selected in this demo.`)}> {tool.label} ))} More {more.map((tool) => ( setFeedback(`${tool.label} selected in this demo.`)}> {tool.label} ))} setPrompt(event.target.value)} onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.nativeEvent.isComposing && prompt.trim()) { setFeedback(`Prompt prepared in this demo: ${prompt.trim()}`); setPrompt(''); } }} aria-label='Ask anything' placeholder='Ask anything' className='px-1' /> {/* Multi-line composer: context chips above, model and actions below. */} brief.pdf 1 tab setDraft(event.target.value)} aria-label='Plan, search, build anything' placeholder='Plan, search, build anything' className='min-h-16' /> setWebSearch((current) => !current)} > Search {model} {models.map((item) => ( setModel(item)}> {item} ))}
{ setFeedback(`Prompt prepared with ${model}${webSearch ? ' and search' : ''}: ${draft.trim()}`); setDraft(''); }} variant='default' size='icon-xs'>

{feedback || 'Local composer demo. Recording, attachments and mentions are host integrations.'}

); }
